title: the board titles every task it can from records firstmate already keeps, and a task the plan does not list can still be dropped from the board
acceptance: Why. On 2026-10-05 the captain's board showed 28 of its 175 tasks with the missing-title label 'Title missing from design/tasks.json' / 'design/tasks.json 未列出標題' (i18n key titleMissing, rendered at board/public/index.html:508 and in the voyage at board/public/ship.js:168, :515). The board reads titles only from design/tasks via taskDefs (board/server.ts:407-431) into `definitions` (:792-798), and a task's `title` is `d.title` or null (:988). Four groups: (A) live tasks whose spec now exists only on an open PR branch, because firstmate removes the untracked local seed design/tasks/<id>.json once the PR opens (T-196, T-198, T-200, T-201 at the time); their spec, title included, is in the dispatch pin `state/pins/<task>/<n>.json` field `snapshots.spec.text`. (B) skill-update tasks SK-001..SK-009, whose titles are in `state/skill-updates/<id>.json` `.title` (only SK-007 has a design/tasks file). (C) finished history with no spec anywhere (e.g. T-099, T-105, T-107), several of which have a `decision_requested` event whose bilingual `summary` names the task (e.g. 'T-105: one permission policy for every crew round and every vendor'). (D) stale definition-less tasks still shown as live work: T-060, T-064, T-075, T-097 (only 2026-09-24/25 decision events), SK-006 and SK-009 (answered skill-update cards) and T-100 (worker crashed 2026-09-26, no spec, no PR). The captain cannot clear (D) because `actions` (:1003-1004) offers park/drop only when `definitions.has(id)`, so a definition-less unfinished task has no action at all.

Title fallback, server side. In the task builder (board/server.ts:977-1012), a task's `title` is taken from the first of these that yields a non-empty string, in this order, read from the task's own project state dir (`stateDir(project)`, :583), never across projects: (1) its design/tasks definition `.title` (unchanged; definitions still win); (2) the dispatch pin with the highest numeric <n> among `state/pins/<task>/<n>.json` (numeric, so 10 beats 9): parse `snapshots.spec.text` as JSON and take its `.title`; (3) `state/skill-updates/<id>.json` `.title`; (4) the EARLIEST `decision_requested` event in the log for that (project, task) that has a `summary.en` string: its first line, with a leading `Dispatch ` or `派工 ` and then a leading `<task id>:` or `<task id>：` (and following spaces) removed, cut to 200 characters with a trailing '…' when longer; the same treatment applied to `summary['zh-TW']`, when present, gives a new field `title_tw` (null otherwise). Sources 1-3 give `title_tw: null`. Path safety: sources 2 and 3 are consulted only when the task id matches `/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$/` (the pattern `readinessCard` already uses before building a state path, board/server.ts:909) and does not contain `..`; any other id (one written to events.jsonl by hand, e.g. `../../x`) skips straight to source 4, so no path outside the project's own state dir is ever listed or read. A pin directory or pin file, or a skill-update file, that is a symbolic link is skipped (checked with lstat), as bin/lib/fm_spec_pins.py:227 refuses symlinked pins. Any file that is missing, unreadable, not JSON, or has a non-string or empty title is skipped silently and the next source is tried; nothing is written, created or deleted. A task none of these titles keeps `title: null` and the existing missing-title label, as today (the e2e fixture T-ABSENT, which has only a `dispatched` event, stays untitled: tests/e2e/board-layout.spec.ts:72, :124). PR titles are not a source: they are not recorded locally and the board makes no network call for them. The reads are cheap and bounded: pins and skill-update files are read at most once per state request per task (a per-request Map is enough), and the decision summaries come from the event replay the builder already performs.

External projects. The two views differ today and keep differing: the engine-wide view (no `?project=`) is the allow-listed `metadata()` projection inside `if (!only)` (board/server.ts:1353-1380), which nulls `title` for an external project (:1379); a selected project's own view (`?project=<name>`) already sends that project's titles (tests/board-projects.test.sh:116, :130, :371 assert it). This task keeps both rules: `title_tw` is not added to the metadata allow-list (the `keys` set at :1354-1357), so the engine-wide view never sends `title_tw` and still sends `title: null` for an external project's task, whatever its fallback found; the selected view `?project=<name>` sends that project's fallback `title` and `title_tw` like any other field of its own local view. Tests in tests/board-projects.test.sh, using the existing external project `beta` and its state (`private_state`, :112): append, after the existing checks at :148 and :167, a `dispatched` event with actor `captain` for beta's T-077 (beta's task list defines only T-001, T-002 and T-004, tests/board-projects.test.sh:45-48, so the event is what makes T-077 a task) and write a pin `pins/T-077/1.json` with spec title 'beta pin title', and append a `decision_requested` event with actor `captain` for T-078 with summary 'T-078: beta decided' / 'T-078：beta 決定' into beta's state; assert that in the engine-wide request (`sh_` with no query) the tasks `beta`/T-077 and `beta`/T-078 have `title: null` and no `title_tw` key and the response text lacks 'beta pin title' and 'beta decided'; and that in `sh_ '?project=beta'` T-077's title is 'beta pin title' and T-078's title is 'beta decided' with title_tw 'beta 決定'.

Title rendering, page side. board/public/index.html's `title` helper (:508) shows `task.title_tw` when the page language is zh-TW or zh-CN and `title_tw` is a non-empty string (through the existing `words()` conversion for zh-CN, :324), and `task.title` otherwise; the `missing` class and `t("titleMissing")` fallback are unchanged. The voyage (board/public/ship.js) is not changed: it keeps showing `c.title`, which is now filled for groups A-C. The comment above the helper (index.html:506-507, '...it never borrows one') is rewritten to say the server supplies the title from the task's own records (definition, pin, skill-update proposal or the first decision about it) and the page never invents one. No i18n key is added or changed.

Drop a task the plan does not list. In the `actions` expression (board/server.ts:1003-1004) a task with no definition whose lane is not final (`FINAL`, :807) now offers `["drop"]` only (no park), and a parked definition-less task (reachable through a card effect `park`, EFFECTS at :310, e.g. on a skill-update task) now offers `["unpark","drop"]`, what ACTIONS['parked'] offers a defined task (a change: on base it offers nothing); a final definition-less task keeps offering `reopen` as today; defined tasks are unchanged. The comment above it (:999-1002, 'only work the plan lists can be set aside...') is rewritten to say a task the log alone knows can only be dropped, so the captain can clear stale work without a plan entry. POST /tasks (:2230-2275) needs no new branch: it already looks the task up in `state().tasks` and checks `task.actions`, so drop on such a task runs the existing `setAside(project, id, 'drop', null)` (:1676) path (the captain's `closed` event, then the one stop path for any crew), `confirm` still applies when crew is aboard or a PR is open, park on it is refused with 409 as for any action not offered, and a task the log has never mentioned stays 404 (tests/board-task-actions.test.sh:136 'T-NOPE'). Nothing is deleted, no event is hand-written, design/tasks is never edited (the existing 'design/tasks/ is untouched' assertion at :147 keeps passing).

Tests. New tests/board-titles.test.sh (fixture and board start in the style of tests/board-task-actions.test.sh:1-45, sourcing tests/lib/project-storage.sh and tests/lib/board.sh, its own temp root, FM_PORT=0):
- design/tasks defines T-D1 'from the plan'; a pin state/pins/T-D1/1.json whose spec title is 'from a pin' must not override it ('definitions win').
- T-PIN has pins 9.json ('pin nine') and 10.json ('pin ten') and no definition: title 'pin ten' (numeric order), title_tw null.
- T-BAD has a 1.json that is not JSON and a decision_requested event 'T-BAD: from the decision' / 'T-BAD：決定裡的標題': title 'from the decision', title_tw '決定裡的標題' (a broken pin is skipped).
- SK-901 has state/skill-updates/SK-901.json title 'skill-update: worker': title 'skill-update: worker'.
- T-DEC has two decision_requested events, first 'Dispatch T-DEC: the first thing' / '派工 T-DEC：第一件事', later 'Merge #9: something else': title 'the first thing', title_tw '第一件事' (earliest wins, prefixes stripped).
- T-LONG's summary is 250 characters with a second line: title is the first line cut to 200 characters plus '…'.
- T-LOG has only a dispatched event: title null, title_tw null.
- A hostile id: an event line written straight into the fixture's state/events.jsonl (not through fm-emit) with task `../escape`, type `decision_requested` and summary 'from the log'. Exactly where an unguarded server would look, the fixture writes `<state>/escape/1.json` (a pin whose `snapshots.spec.text` has title 'from outside') and `<state>/escape.json` (a skill-update-shaped file with title 'from outside'), where <state> is the fixture's own state dir (e.g. `$f/state`): join(stateDir, 'pins', '../escape') is `<state>/escape` and join(stateDir, 'skill-updates', '../escape.json') is `<state>/escape.json`. The board's title for that task is 'from the log' (source 4), never 'from outside', and the board keeps serving. This case is red on a server without the id check.
- T-LINK's state/pins/T-LINK is a symbolic link to a directory holding 1.json titled 'linked pin', and it has a decision_requested 'T-LINK: from the decision': title 'from the decision' (the symlinked pin is skipped).
Fail-first: every case but 'definitions win' and T-LOG is red on base (title null there); those two are regression guards and are labelled as such in the suite.
Every new fixture event in every suite is written with actor `captain` (the deck skips it, board/server.ts:~1129-1135, so it adds no crew row), except the hostile-id line, which is also actor `captain`. Extend tests/board-task-actions.test.sh: a definition-less task T-LOGONLY with only a `decision_requested` event (actor captain) offers exactly `drop`; `act T-LOGONLY park` is 409 and writes nothing; `act T-LOGONLY drop` is 200, its stage becomes `closed`, the last event is type `closed` with actor `captain`; afterwards it offers `reopen`. A definition-less task T-LOGPARK with a `decision_requested` and then a `parked` event (both actor captain) has stage `parked` and offers exactly `unpark,drop`; `act T-LOGPARK unpark` is 200 and it then offers `drop` only. A definition-less task with an open PR (a `pr_opened` event) offers `drop` with `confirm: true` and drop without confirm is 409 `confirmRequired`. These are red on base (actions empty, drop 409).
Extend tests/e2e/board-layout.spec.ts: add a fixture task T-DECIDED with only an `emitFixture(root,'captain','T-DECIDED','decision_requested','Dispatch T-DECIDED: a decided title','派工 T-DECIDED：決定的標題')` event; in English its card title reads 'a decided title', in zh-TW '決定的標題', in zh-CN the converted text; T-ABSENT still reads the missing-title text in all three (unchanged assertions at :72, :124). Extend tests/board-projects.test.sh as in the external-projects line above.
Callers and pins checked by grep, expected to stay green unchanged: tests/board-card-effects.test.sh:261, :287, :375 (defined or merged tasks' actions), tests/board-projects.test.sh:130, :371 (titles of defined tasks), tests/e2e/board-task-actions.spec.ts (defined tasks' menus), tests/e2e/game.spec.ts:197 (finds a task whose actions include park; definition-less tasks never offer park, so it still finds a defined one), tests/e2e/lib/board.ts:13, :22 (titleMissing keys unchanged), tests/e2e/board-layout.spec.ts:96 (exactly 4 + 1 roster rows: the new captain-actor event adds none), tests/board-projects.test.sh:148 (worker-b1 on beta T-001) and :167 (beta's crew is exactly `firstmate worker-b1`: the new beta T-077 and T-078 events are actor captain and are appended after those checks), board/public/ship.js (unchanged).

Docs, edited in place (T-189 rule; nothing appended at the end of design.md), in design/design.md §8 'The captain's board': (a) the '**Lanes and cards.**' paragraph's sentence 'A task absent from `design/tasks/` shows its id and an explicit missing-title label.' becomes the fallback order above (definition, newest dispatch pin, skill-update proposal, earliest decision_requested summary, else the missing-title label), says titles are read from the task's own project state, are sent for an external project only in that project's own selected view and never in the engine-wide view, and says `title_tw` carries the Chinese summary when the title came from a decision; (b) the '**Park and drop (T-058, T-118).**' paragraph gains one sentence: a task the log knows but the plan does not list offers only `drop` (no park) in an active lane, `unpark` and `drop` if it was parked (for example by a card effect), so the captain can clear stale definition-less work through the same confirmed path, and `reopen` once final.

In flight and migration. Nothing is migrated and no state file is written. Open PRs at the time of writing: #188 (T-196, CI), #190 (T-199, worker notes) and #159 (T-055); #189 (T-200) has merged; none touches board/server.ts or board/public/index.html, so no overlap. On the live board, the 28 untitled tasks get titles where a source exists, and the seven stale tasks (T-060, T-064, T-075, T-097, T-100, SK-006, SK-009) start offering `drop`; the captain decides whether to click it, card by card; this task drops nothing itself. The board must be restarted after merge to load the new server (firstmate does that).

Workers do not run the suites. Evidence is the required GitHub check and the six gates. Fail-first is expected from tests/board-titles.test.sh (all fallback cases), tests/board-task-actions.test.sh (definition-less drop) and tests/e2e/board-layout.spec.ts (T-DECIDED title); the 'definitions win', T-LOG and T-ABSENT assertions are regression guards, green on base and head. No vendor stub is involved.
